cats.title: Amuse-Bouche
cats.blurb: The first bite sets the promise. Precise, cold-kitchen work built to be eaten in one or two mouthfuls.

cats.title: Appetisers
cats.blurb: Bold, spiced small plates to open the meal: fried crisp, finished with fresh herbs and lime.

cats.title: Mains
cats.blurb: Hot-line cooking with discipline: sauces built properly, pasta cooked with nerve, plates that leave the pass clean.

cats.title: Live Stations
cats.kicker: In full view of the guest
cats.blurb: Cooking as theatre. Carving, tossing, grilling and plating to order, while talking to the people you are cooking for.

cats.title: Confections
cats.blurb: Where patience is non-negotiable. Tempered chocolate, set mousses and pâtisserie finished by hand.

dishes.name: Arabic Mezze Platter
dishes.short: Ten Levantine components on one tray
dishes.description: A ten-component Levantine spread, plated tray-style so every dip, crisp and crudité has its own place.
dishes.story: Built like a map: cool labneh and smoky baba ganoush beside a sweet-hot muhammara and a vivid beetroot hummus, with sumac chickpeas, lavash, tortilla crisps, pita and crudités for crunch, and an arugula house salad served high in a coupe. Every element is portioned, garnished and placed with intent.

dishes.name: Liver Pâté Canapé
dishes.short: Silken pâté, crisp shell, textured glass
dishes.description: Silken liver pâté piped into crisp tart shells, set on toasted pumpkin seeds over textured glass.
dishes.story: A canapé is a test of control. The pâté is passed until completely smooth, piped at an even height and finished with a glossy garnish. Served on a bed of toasted pumpkin seeds over bubbled glass, so the light does half the plating.

dishes.name: Forester Phyllo Blossoms
dishes.short: Hors d’oeuvre from the Gala Dinner menu
dishes.description: Buttery phyllo shells folded into blossoms and filled with a savoury mushroom mousse and sautéed spinach.
dishes.story: The opening course of a gala menu. Sheets of phyllo are brushed, layered and shaped into open flowers, baked crisp, then filled with a woodland mushroom mousse. Served in a bamboo steamer with edible flowers, the forest presented as a small bite.

dishes.name: Chicken & Mushroom Stroganoff
dishes.description: Chicken and mushrooms in a velvet cream sauce, with buttery mash and honey-garlic glazed vegetables.
dishes.story: The main course of the gala menu. The mushrooms are seared hard for colour before the sauce is built, and the cream is reduced slowly so it coats rather than floods. Plated alongside smooth mashed potato and vegetables glazed in a sweet and savoury honey-garlic reduction.

dishes.name: The Carving Station
dishes.description: Whole roasts carved to order, surrounded by roasted roots, charred citrus and seasonal greens.
dishes.story: A carving station is part kitchen, part stage. Whole birds and joints are roasted, rested and carved in front of the guest, with a ring of roasted vegetables and citrus that keeps the board as generous at the end of service as it was at the start.

dishes.name: Thirteen Handmade Pastas
dishes.short: One cook, thirteen shapes, one Gala Dinner
dishes.description: Thirteen pasta varieties, all mixed, rolled, cut and filled by hand by one cook for a Gala Dinner pasta bar.
dishes.story: Ribbons first: fettuccine, tagliatelle, pappardelle. Then the filled shapes: mezzelune, cappelletti, agnolotti. Then the small ones: sorpresine, barchette, farfalle. Naturally coloured doughs, all single-handed. "The ribbons teach you the dough. The filled shapes teach you patience, and that a rushed seal always shows."

dishes.name: Chicken 65
dishes.description: Chicken marinated in chilli, ginger and curry leaf, fried crisp and finished with a tempered glaze and lime.
dishes.story: Regional Indian food, cooked with the same precision as the Western menu. The marinade is balanced for heat and tang, the fry is done in two stages for a crunch that survives the glaze, and the plate is finished with fresh herbs and lime.

dishes.name: Salad on the Go
dishes.short: Crisp, bright and built for service
dishes.description: Crisp leaves, pomegranate, shaved cheese and a bright vinaigrette, made fresh and fast for high-volume service.
dishes.story: Freshness at volume. Leaves washed, spun and kept cold, dressings emulsified per batch, and garnishes such as pomegranate, cheese and microgreens placed so every bowl looks like the first one.

dishes.name: Paris-Brest, Choux & Crème Brûlée
dishes.description: A cream-filled Paris-Brest ring, velvet-coated choux finished with edible flowers, and a torched crème brûlée.
dishes.story: Three classical techniques on one table: choux paste piped into a ring and baked hollow and crisp for the Paris-Brest, then filled with cream; choux buns coated in a velvet spray for a matte, mossy finish; and a custard set gently and torched to a glass-thin crust.

dishes.name: Gianduja Mousse
dishes.description: Thirty percent hazelnut, seventy percent chocolate: a glossy set mousse finished with a lace tuile and fresh fruit.
dishes.story: Gianduja is Piedmont’s marriage of hazelnut and chocolate. Here it is folded into a mousse with a 30/70 balance, set until it slices clean, and finished with a crisp lace tuile and fruit for acidity.

dishes.name: Cheese Board Under Glass
dishes.description: A curated cheese board served under a glass cloche: hard and soft cheeses, fruit, nuts, olives and crackers.
dishes.story: Cheese service is about temperature, cut and rhythm. Each cheese is cut to suit its texture and arranged from mild to bold, then paired with fruit, nuts and crackers so the guest can build every bite.

dishes.name: Roast Chicken
dishes.description: Roast chicken glazed with its pan jus, with charred asparagus, herbed rice and scored potato on a fluted plate.
dishes.story: A Western main plated for symmetry: protein dead centre, a glaze reduced until it mirrors the light, asparagus laid in parallel and the starch shaped beneath. Clean rim, no smears.

dishes.name: Awadhi Thali
dishes.description: A full Awadhi thali on brass: galouti and tikka to begin, then biryani, korma and sides in katoris, with sheermal.
dishes.story: Awadhi cooking is about slow, layered aroma. The thali is built course by course: a kebab plate to begin, then a brass thali with fragrant pulao topped with fried onions, curries and raita in individual katoris, crisp rolls and breads on the side. It is styled on red cloth with whole spices, makhana and wheat sheaves, so the presentation tells the story before the first bite.

dishes.name: Spaghetti all'Assassina
dishes.description: Bari's "assassin's" spaghetti, cooked straight in a ferociously hot pan until the strands char, crackle and caramelise.
dishes.story: No pot of boiling water. Raw spaghetti goes into a blistering pan with garlic, chilli and oil, then is fed ladle by ladle with a light tomato broth. The skill is nerve: letting the pasta catch and blacken without burning, so every strand carries a smoky crunch around a soft, sticky centre. Finished with Parmigiano and parsley.

dishes.name: Paneer Cafreal
dishes.short: Goan green masala, made with paneer
dishes.description: Paneer in a Goan-style cafreal masala of fresh coriander, green chilli and spice, finished with lime.
dishes.story: Cafreal is a Goan green masala: coriander, green chilli, garlic, ginger and whole spices ground fresh and cooked down until fragrant. Here it coats paneer, served on an oval plate with lime and herbs.

dishes.name: Mushroom Hara Pyaaz
dishes.description: Mushrooms cooked in a spiced masala with fresh spring onion greens, finished with julienned vegetables and cream.
dishes.story: A regional Indian vegetarian main built on the freshness of hara pyaaz (spring onion). The mushrooms are seared before going into the masala so they stay meaty, and the onion greens go in at the end for colour and bite.

dishes.name: The Caesar Salad Station
dishes.short: Conceptualised & run as a live station
dishes.description: A live Caesar station I conceptualised and ran: dressing emulsified to order, toppings built in front of the guest.
dishes.story: Responsible for conceptualising and operating a live Caesar Salad Station, offering a unique and engaging dining experience. Crisp romaine, croutons, Parmesan and a full spread of toppings, assembled and dressed to order while talking guests through every element.

dishes.name: Hand-Tossed Pizza
dishes.description: Dough stretched and tossed by hand at the live counter, then fired to order in the oven.
dishes.story: Italian at the counter: dough balls proofed for the day, opened and tossed by hand in front of guests, topped with restraint and fired until the cornicione blisters.

dishes.name: Fire & Grill
dishes.short: Open flame and flambé, cooked in the moment
dishes.description: Open-fire grilling and flambé at a live outdoor station, with flame, smoke and timing in front of the guest.
dishes.story: Cooking over live fire is all about reading heat. Flare-ups are managed, not feared, the flambé is timed for the guest, and every piece comes off the grate with char outside and juice inside.

dishes.name: Pani Puri Station
dishes.short: Street-food classic, set up for service
dishes.description: A live pani puri setup: crisp puris, spiced potato, and chilled tamarind and mint waters in jugs, assembled to order.
dishes.story: Street food at hotel standard. Puris fried crisp and kept dry, pani spiced and chilled in jugs, and every filling, chutney and masala portioned into its own bowl, so each puri is assembled and served the second it is ordered.

dishes.name: South Indian Breakfast
dishes.description: Running the South Indian breakfast operation: dosa to order with chutneys, podi and accompaniments.
dishes.story: Breakfast service at scale. Batters fermented the night before, chutneys and podis prepared fresh, and dosas spread thin and crisp to order, with the mise en place laid out like a palette.

dishes.name: Hand-Piped Bonbons
dishes.description: Moulded chocolate bonbons: tempered shells filled by hand with piped ganache and sealed clean.
dishes.story: Chocolate rewards discipline. Shells are tempered for snap and shine, filled with a piping bag one cavity at a time, and capped without a smear, so the finished bonbon releases with a mirror finish.

dishes.name: Gooseberry & Beet Botanicals
dishes.description: Hand-rolled botanicals of coconut, beetroot and gooseberry, finished in crystal sugar and packed into glass.
dishes.story: A confection built on natural colour and tang. Coconut is cooked down with sugar, beetroot for its deep jewel colour and gooseberry for a sharp, fruity bite, then weighed, rolled by hand into identical spheres and coated in sugar for sparkle and crunch.

dishes.name: The Classical Mousse
dishes.description: A classical chocolate mousse, set and plated for a menu tasting alongside its menu card.
dishes.story: Mousse is air held in place: chocolate, eggs and cream folded with a light hand so the bubbles survive, then set until it slices clean. Plated for a menu tasting, presented with the menu card beside it.

dishes.name: Couscous & Feta Bowls
dishes.description: Individual couscous bowls with pomegranate, cucumber and crumbled feta, portioned identically for service.
dishes.story: Cold-kitchen work at volume: every bowl filled to the same line, garnished in the same order, with a cucumber sail for height, so the hundredth bowl looks like the first.

info.name: Uddipan Datta
info.intro: I'm Uddipan Datta, a Culinary Associate on The Oberoi's Systematic Training & Education Programme at Trident Agra. Two years in luxury hotel kitchens, cooking Western, Italian and regional Indian food through high-volume service and at live stations, in full view of the guest.
